captions.detailed: A miniature, boutique-style cash register featuring a light beige rectangular drawer base, a dark brown elevated keypad pod, and a small black display unit. The drawer is designed to slide straight forward out of the base, revealing an open tray. On top of the dark brown pod is a grid of small, pastel-colored square keys (pinks, greens, yellows, and blues) that act as individual push buttons, while the rear display unit is mounted on a horizontal hinge to flip up or down.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a boutique cash register with a sliding drawer, a raised keypad pod, a flip-up rear customer display, and a grid of small colored push keys. Ensure the drawer moves on a forward prismatic axis, the display flips on a rear revolute axis, and each key has its own prismatic vertical movement.
captions.factory: Construct the main base housing using a hollowed-out box primitive. Model the drawer as a separate box with an inner cavity cutout, connected to the base via a prismatic joint along the Y-axis. Build the elevated keypad pod using a box with filleted vertical edges, and populate its top surface with a grid of small boxes representing keys, each attached with a vertical prismatic joint. Add a small display assembly at the rear of the keypad pod, connected via a revolute joint to enable rotational movement.
